unit.why: A short anecdote: the holy rabbi meets a powerful wicked man, grabs his garment and urges him to repent. It ends with an exegetical note linking the episode to his teaching on penitents.

stories.start_quote: פ״א פגע הרה״ק מבא"ד באדם רשע
stories.summary_en: The holy rabbi of B. seizes a powerful wicked man, the town's judge, by his garment and urges him to repent, saying he envies him because a great sinner's repentance turns his sins into merits; the text links this to the rabbi's exegesis in 'Siftei Tzaddikim' of the saying on penitents.
